decomposition_limits: Twelve closed copper winding packets and24commutator segments are aggregate subdivisions, not measured electrical winding topology. Interconnections, individual lamination sheets and insulation layers remain unresolved.
The solenoid coil is an aggregate hollow envelope; pull/hold winding circuits and contact bridge are not fabricated from unsupported geometry.
Six straight shaft splines mate with matching drive-clutch slots; count/form/helix remain provisional. Overrunning clutch rollers, ramps and springs are not invented.
Rest-state lever, pivot, clevis and plunger are decomposed. Engagement testing translates the drive clutch and pinion; full solenoid/lever articulation is not claimed.
No battery cable, vehicle harness, bellhousing, mounting bolts into absent material or index-plate interface is fabricated.
